description: Structural diff of two JSON documents as JSON-Patch-style operations. Compares two JSON values key by key and index by index and returns add / remove / replace operations with JSON Pointer paths and old and new values (up to 2,000 operations). Price: $0.003 USDC per call via x402 (eip155:8453).
